title.en: Northern Territory MP Luke Gosling steps down as defence envoy after assault charge
title.zh: 北领地议员卢克·高斯林在袭击指控后辞去国防特使职务

summary.en: Gosling says he "categorically denies" the charges against him and will defend himself in court.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A Labor politician in the Northern Territory has stood aside from an envoy role after he was charged by police for a second time.

Darwin-based Luke Gosling, who holds the federal seat of Solomon, is facing fresh accusations of breaching his bail conditions.

He was originally charged in July with the assault of Northern Territory Administrator David Connolly, the jurisdiction's equivalent to a state governor.

In a statement on Wednesday, Gosling announced his decision to step down until the matters have been dealt with in court.

"Due to the ongoing media attention and the distraction this is causing to the business of government, I have decided to temporarily stand aside as Special Envoy for Defence, Veterans' Affairs and Northern Australia," Gosling said in a post on social media.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I am more committed than ever to my role serving the people of Darwin and Palmerston."

Gosling vowed to "rigorously" defend himself against the charges in court and strongly denies the allegations.

Gosling was charged on Tuesday with one count of breach of bail and is due to appear in Darwin Local Court on 30 September.

Earlier on Wednesday, Opposition leader Angus Taylor said the prime minister faced an even "stronger test" of his leadership since charges were first laid.

"[Anthony Albanese] must act. It's completely unacceptable for a second charge to be placed on Luke Gosling. He should be stood down," he told ABC News Breakfast.

"Presumption of innocence is important in our system, but he should be stood down whilst these proceedings continue."

The assault is alleged to have occurred at the NT Thailand Grand Festival in Darwin on 18 July, with Gosling posting photos from the event on social media that day.

"You've gotta get punted, mate. I don't know, let's see what Mr Albanese does," he told News24.

NT Chief Minister Lia Finocchiaro said the matter was for Albanese to deal with.

"Ultimately, if all of these allegations are true, it clearly doesn't meet the expectation of our community," she told ABC radio.

Gosling's lawyer, Marty Aust, has previously criticised police for arresting the politician at his home rather than issuing him a summons or notice to appear.

As part of his bail conditions, Gosling is banned from going within 50 metres of the NT's Government House building and must give the administrator's office 48 hours' notice before attending any event where the two men would be present.

If they are at an event together, the Labor politician must not be within 15m of Connolly.

title.en: Inflation has eased, but here's why the RBA may not be breathing a sigh of relief just yet
title.zh: 通货膨胀已经缓解，但这就是为什么澳洲联储可能还没有松一口气的原因

summary.en: Despite falling to its lowest level in eight months, inflation is still higher than consensus expectations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Australia's headline inflation rate has come in above expectations despite falling to its lowest level in eight months.

The consumer price index rose 1 per cent in July, with the annual rate of inflation falling to   3.5   per cent, the Australian Bureau of Statistics reported on Wednesday.

Largely as a result of a decline in the growth of electricity prices, headline inflation was down from 3.8 per cent in the year to June and the lowest level since November.

Worryingly for the Reserve Bank, trimmed mean inflation — a measure of underlying inflation that strips out volatile items — held steady at 3.6 per cent, above expectations for a fall to 3.5 per cent.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Housing was the largest contributor to inflation, up 5 per cent, said ABS head of price statistics Rachael McCririck.

"New dwellings prices rose 5.7 per cent in the 12 months to July as builders passed on higher costs for materials and labour," she said.

Fuel prices rose 7.5 per cent in the month after falling for three months in a row.

"This was driven by higher world oil prices and the partial unwinding of the federal government's fuel excise relief measures in July," McCririck said.

Food and non-alcoholic beverages were also strong contributors in the month, rising 3.2 per cent, as well as recreation and culture, which rose 2.6 per cent.

Minutes from the RBA's August board meeting, released on Tuesday, showed the board was concerned about upside risks to inflation.

body.zh: 尽管澳大利亚的总体通胀率降至八个月来的最低水平，但仍高于预期。 澳大利亚统计局周三报告称，7 月份消费者价格指数上涨 1%，年通胀率降至 3.5%。 主要由于电价增幅下降，总体通胀率从截至 6 月份的一年中的 3.8% 下降，为 11 月份以来的最低水平。 令储备银行担忧的是，调整后的平均通胀率（剔除波动性项目的基本通胀指标）稳定在 3.6%，高于预期的跌至 3.5%。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 ABS 价格统计主管 Rachael McCririck 表示，住房是通货膨胀的最大贡献者，上涨了 5%。 她说：“截至 7 月份的 12 个月里，新住宅价格上涨了 5.7%，因为建筑商转嫁了材料和劳动力成本上涨。” 燃油价格在连续三个月下跌后，本月上涨 7.5%。 麦克里里克表示：“这是由于世界油价上涨以及联邦政府在 7 月份部分取消燃油消费税减免措施所推动的。” 食品和非酒精饮料也是本月的强劲贡献者，增长了 3.2%，娱乐和文化也增长了 2.6%。 周二公布的澳洲联储八月份董事会会议纪要显示，董事会对通胀上行风险感到担忧。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

body.en: Police on Wednesday said they arrested two women, after viral video footage showed a young girl being slapped in the face. In the video circulating online, a girl can be seen falling to the ground after being struck. It is understood that two 34-year-old mothers took their children to the APM shopping mall in Kwun Tong at around 4pm, when an argument broke out over the use of play facilities. During the dispute, a 68-year-old, who is the mother of one of the women, allegedly slapped the five-year-old girl. The girl's mother is also suspected of assaulting the other 34-year-old woman. Three people were taken to United Christian Hospital for treatment. The Kwun Tong District Crime Division is looking into the incident. Edited by Aaron Tam

title.en: North Korea to ‘bring joy’ to Kim with 100 athletes at Asian Games
title.zh: 朝鲜将携100名运动员参加亚运会为金正恩“带来欢乐”

summary.en: North Korea will send about 100 athletes to compete across 14 sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month, a senior official said, aiming to “bring joy to Marshal Kim Jong Un”. The nuclear-armed state suspended participation in international sporting competitions during the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: North Korea will send about 100 athletes to compete across 14 sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month, a senior official said, aiming to “bring joy to Marshal Kim Jong Un”. This picture taken on August 16, 2026 and released by North Korea’s official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) via KNS on August 17, 2026 shows North Korean leader Kim Jong Un (centre R) and his daughter Kim Ju Ae watching swimming and diving competitions, to mark the 81st anniversary of the end of World War II in Pyongyang. Photo: KCNA via KNS/AFP. The nuclear-armed state suspended participation in international sporting competitions during the Covid pandemic but returned at the Asian Games in China in 2023 and also took part in the Paris Olympics. The team for the regional Games in Nagoya and the Aichi region includes two Japan-based ethnic Koreans competing in women’s football and karate, said Ko Chol Ho, secretary general of North Korea’s Olympic committee. “Our delegation will send more than 100 athletes to compete in 14 sports, including men’s and women’s football, weightlifting, boxing and wrestling,” Ko told Choson Sinbo, a pro-North Korean publication based in Japan, during an interview in Pyongyang. Kim Jong Un. File photo: USGov. “We are making every effort, driven by a strong desire to live up to the expectations of our country and people by achieving even greater results at the upcoming Games,” the official said, in remarks published Tuesday. He noted that the delegation would be smaller than the one sent to the Hangzhou Games of 2023 but said he hoped it would win more medals. Authoritarian North Korea won 11 golds last time, half of them in weightlifting. The official said that morale among the athletes was high for the event, which runs from September 19 to October 4, and they were motivated to win for their leader. “Our athletes are training tirelessly every day, determined to bring joy to Marshal Kim,” he said. North Korea has recently been hurling criticism at Japan, a former regional colonial power, over what Pyongyang describes as its remilitarisation.
body.zh: 一名高级官员表示，朝鲜将派出约 100 名运动员参加下个月在日本举行的亚运会，参加 14 个项目的比赛，旨在“为金正恩元帅带来欢乐”。这张拍摄于 2026 年 8 月 16 日、朝鲜官方朝中社 (KCNA) 通过 KNS 于 2026 年 8 月 17 日发布的照片​​显示，朝鲜领导人金正恩（中右）和他的女儿金珠爱正在观看游泳和跳水比赛，以纪念平壤第二次世界大战结束 81 周年。照片：朝中社/法新社。这个拥有核武器的国家在新冠病毒大流行期间暂停了参加国际体育比赛，但在 2023 年中国亚运会上回归，还参加了巴黎奥运会。朝鲜奥委会秘书长高哲浩表示，参加名古屋和爱知地区地区运动会的代表队包括两名居住在日本的朝鲜族选手，她们参加女子足球和空手道比赛。 “我们代表团将派出100多名运动员参加14个项目的比赛，包括男女足球、举重、拳击和摔跤，”高在平壤接受采访时告诉日本亲朝鲜出版物《朝鲜新报》。金正恩.资料图：美国政府。这位官员在周二发表的讲话中表示：“我们正在尽一切努力，强烈希望在即将到来的奥运会上取得更好的成绩，不辜负我们国家和人民的期望。”他指出，代表团规模将比参加 2023 年杭州奥运会的代表团规模要小，但他表示希望代表团能赢得更多奖牌。独裁的朝鲜上次赢得了 11 枚金牌，其中一半是举重金牌。这位官员表示，在9月19日至10月4日举行的这项赛事中，运动员们士气高昂，他们有动力为自己的领袖赢得胜利。 “我们的运动员每天都在不知疲倦地训练，决心为金元帅带来欢乐，”他说。朝鲜最近一直对前地区殖民国家日本提出批评，平壤称其为重新军事化。

title.en: Hong Kong’s first Chinese medicine hospital to offer inpatient services from December
title.zh: 香港首间中医院12月起提供住院服务

summary.en: The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong will begin offering hospitalisation services in December, with fees starting at three times those of public hospitals. The Tseung Kwan O facility, which opened last December, will launch 24-hour inpatient care from December 11,...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong will begin offering hospitalisation services in December, with fees starting at three times those of public hospitals. The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong. Photo: GovHK. The Tseung Kwan O facility, which opened last December, will launch 24-hour inpatient care from December 11, authorities said on Tuesday. It currently provides only outpatient and day-patient services. A total of 93 beds will be made available. This includes 60 government-subsidised beds, available to eligible Hong Kong residents, as well as 33 non-subsidised ones. The hospital will also provide 20 beds under its Clinical Trial and Research Centre, and two high-dependency beds for patients who require closer observation and nursing care. The total number of beds is expected to reach 400 by the end of 2030. The city’s first hospital dedicated to traditional Chinese medicine, the facility operates under a public-private partnership model. It is managed by a company set up by Hong Kong Baptist University, which was selected as the project contractor in 2021 following a government tender process. Hong Kong Baptist University. Photo: GovHK. The hospital uses two fee structures: one for subsidised services and another for more expensive “market-oriented services.” Inpatient services will cost $980 under the subsidised scheme – more than three times the day charge for a public hospital bed, which is currently priced at HK$300. For non-subsidised beds, fees range from HK$810 to HK$3,100 per day, depending on the room type. These rates do not include medical attendance or consultation, which start from HK$560 per visit. More services expanded In addition to launching inpatient services, the hospital will expand existing outpatient services, including those offered in its radiological diagnostic and pathology departments. The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong. Photo: GovHK. The hospital will also introduce 10 new special disease programmes in September and November, covering conditions such as eczema, Parkinson’s disease, and functional gastrointestinal disorders. “By leveraging the strengths of Chinese medicine and the complementary advantages of Chinese and Western medicine, the multidisciplinary team of the hospital will provide patients with highly effective treatment to enhance clinical outcomes,” the government said in a statement . Authorities predict that annual outpatient attendance will rise from 140,000 in the first year of operation to over 260,000 in the second year.
body.zh: 香港中医院将于12月开始提供住院服务，起价是公立医院的三倍。香港中医院。照片：香港政府一站通。当局周二表示，去年 12 月启用的将军澳医院将于 12 月 11 日起提供 24 小时住院服务。目前仅提供门诊和日间住院服务。共有93张床位可供使用。其中包括60个供合资格香港居民使用的政府资助床位，以及33个非资助床位。医院还将在其临床试验和研究中心下提供20张床位，并为需要密切观察和护理的患者提供两张高依赖床位。预计到2030年底，床位总数将达到400张。该医院是该市第一家中医医院，以公私合作模式运营。该项目由香港浸会大学成立的一家公司管理，该公司于 2021 年通过政府招标程序被选为项目承包商。香港浸会大学。照片：香港政府一站通。该医院采用两种收费结构：一种用于补贴服务，另一种用于更昂贵的“市场导向服务”。根据补贴计划，住院服务费用为 980 美元，是目前公立医院床位日费 300 港元的三倍多。对于非资助床位，收费范围为每日港币 810 元至港币 3,100 元，视乎房型而定。这些费用不包括就诊或咨询，每次就诊 560 港元起。扩大更多服务除了推出住院服务外，医院还将扩大现有的门诊服务，包括放射诊断和病理科提供的服务。香港中医院。照片：香港政府一站通。医院还将在9月和11月推出10个新的专科疾病项目，涵盖湿疹、帕金森病、功能性胃肠病等疾病。政府在一份声明中表示：“医院的多学科团队将利用中医优势和中西医互补优势，为患者提供高效的治疗，以提高临床效果。”当局预计，每年门诊量将从开业第一年的14万人次增加到第二年的26万人次以上。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. title.en: Looking into the eyes of gibbons: New noninvasive eye-tracking study features these little-studied apes
title.zh: 观察长臂猿的眼睛：新的非侵入性眼球追踪研究以这些很少被研究的猿为特征

summary.en: When you look at someone, you usually look at their face. It serves as one of the most important sources of social information in primates, so the evolution of face perception has attracted considerable scientific attention. While an abundance of this research has centered on...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

When you look at someone, you usually look at their face. It serves as one of the most important sources of social information in primates, so the evolution of face perception has attracted considerable scientific attention. While an abundance of this research has centered on humans and other great apes, very little has focused on gibbons.

Gibbons were the earliest to diverge from the line leading to humans 17 million years ago, and they have developed a distinct social system characterized by small family groups and long-term pair bonding. They provide a particularly valuable model for investigating the relationship between social organization and the evolution of social cognition, motivating a team of researchers at Kyoto University to give gibbons the attention they deserve.

"Understanding the evolutionary origins of the human mind requires comparative studies across the ape lineage," says Makiko Uchikoshi, first author of the study published in Animal Behavior and Cognition . "Despite their evolutionary importance, gibbons remain one of the least studied ape groups in cognitive research."

The researchers used a voluntary, noninvasive eye-tracking method—developed for previous studies—to measure the eye movements of three adult male gibbons while they viewed photographs of both gibbon and human faces displayed on a screen. The experiment was conducted in the gibbons' regular living environment, allowing them to participate in or stop the session whenever they wished.

Though the researchers were concerned about the effect that the equipment and dimmed light would have on the subjects' comfort in their home, the gibbons soon began to sit in their designated place and wait while everything was set up. With the resulting data, the team examined how long the gibbons looked at the eyes, nose, mouth and peripheral areas, then compared the responses to gibbon and human faces.

The results reveal that, when viewing both gibbon and human faces, gibbons spend more time looking at the eyes than at other facial regions. Their gazes also linger on the eyes of their own species significantly longer than those of humans, indicating that gibbons share key patterns of visual attention with humans, great apes and macaques while also exhibiting a stronger focus on the eyes of members of their own species.

The success of this eye-tracking approach expands opportunities for comparing species with markedly different social structures and for understanding how social organization has shaped the evolution of social cognition across the primate lineage. These findings also provide new...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 当你看某人时，你通常会看他们的脸。它是灵长类动物最重要的社会信息来源之一，因此面部感知的进化引起了科学界的广泛关注。虽然这项研究大量集中在人类和其他类人猿上，但很少关注长臂猿。 长臂猿是最早在1700万年前从人类的血统中分化出来的，它们已经发展出了一种独特的社会体系，其特点是小家庭群体和长期的配对关系。它们为研究社会组织与社会认知进化之间的关系提供了一个特别有价值的模型，促使京都大学的一组研究人员给予长臂猿应有的关注。 “了解人类思维的进化起源需要对猿类谱系进行比较研究，”发表在《动物行为与认知》杂志上的这项研究的第一作者内越真纪子说。 “尽管长臂猿在进化上很重要，但它仍然是认知研究中研究最少的猿类之一。” 研究人员使用了一种为之前的研究开发的自愿、非侵入性眼球追踪方法，测量三只成年雄性长臂猿在观看屏幕上显示的长臂猿和人脸照片时的眼球运动。该实验是在长臂猿的正常生活环境中进行的，允许它们随时参与或停止实验。 尽管研究人员担心设备和昏暗的灯光会对受试者在家中的舒适度产生影响，但长臂猿很快就开始坐在指定的位置上，等待一切准备就绪。利用所得数据，研究小组检查了长臂猿注视眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴和周围区域的时间，然后比较了长臂猿和人脸的反应。 结果表明，当观察长臂猿和人脸时，长臂猿注视眼睛的时间比注视其他面部区域的时间要多。它们的目光停留在同类眼睛上的时间也明显长于人类，这表明长臂猿与人类、类人猿和猕猴共享视觉注意力的关键模式，同时也表现出对同类成员眼睛的更强烈的关注。 这种眼球追踪方法的成功为比较具有明显不同社会结构的物种以及了解社会组织如何塑造整个灵长类谱系的社会认知进化提供了机会。这些发现还提供了新的...

title.en: Gambling branding dominates Premier League YouTube highlights, new study finds
title.zh: 新研究发现赌博品牌主导英超联赛 YouTube 亮点

summary.en: New research from the University of Nottingham has found that gambling brands were visible in 32% of Premier League soccer highlight footage, compared with less than 2% of FIFA World Cup highlights, raising questions about viewers' exposure to gambling marketing.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

New research from the University of Nottingham has found that gambling brands were visible in 32% of Premier League soccer highlight footage, compared with less than 2% of FIFA World Cup highlights, raising questions about viewers' exposure to gambling marketing.

The study, believed to be the first to analyze and compare exposure to unhealthy commodity branding in soccer highlights on YouTube, was led by researchers from the University of Nottingham. The preprint is available here .

Researchers examined Sky Sports highlights from the final 10 games of the 2025–26 Premier League season and FIFA YouTube highlights from 17 matches during the 2026 World Cup.

They found that unhealthy commodity branding, including gambling, was visible during 38% of Premier League highlight footage, compared with 19% of World Cup highlights.

Gambling was the most prominent unhealthy commodity category in Premier League highlights, with gambling brands visible for 32% of total screen time. By contrast, gambling branding appeared in less than 2% of World Cup highlight footage.

The findings come just days after the new Premier League season began and highlight the extent to which soccer audiences can encounter gambling marketing through match footage itself, beyond conventional ad breaks.

The research also found that only around a quarter of gambling brand appearances in Premier League highlights were on the fronts of players' jerseys—the placement targeted by the Premier League's voluntary agreement to withdraw gambling sponsorship from the front of match jerseys.

Researchers were served up to 30 seconds of gambling ads before approximately three minutes of match footage.

The Premier League says that 1.87 billion people interact with its content through media each week, while the 2022 FIFA World Cup was estimated to have engaged around 5 billion people across media platforms, with 1.42 billion people watching at least one minute of the final.

YouTube highlights are an increasingly popular way of consuming soccer, particularly among younger audiences. In the UK, 81% of 3–17-year-olds regularly use YouTube. Highlights also concentrate some of the most memorable and widely shared moments of matches, including goals and red cards, making them an important source of exposure to branding embedded in soccer coverage.

title.en: Human activity is pushing lakes beyond their natural carbon limits
title.zh: 人类活动正在使湖泊超出其自然碳极限

summary.en: Lakes play an important role in capturing and storing carbon, which accumulates in their sediments. But the amounts they can absorb have varied considerably over time. Jean-François Lapierre, a professor in the Department of Biological Sciences at Université de Montréal, is part...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Lakes play an important role in capturing and storing carbon, which accumulates in their sediments. But the amounts they can absorb have varied considerably over time. Jean-François Lapierre, a professor in the Department of Biological Sciences at Université de Montréal, is part of a research team sorting out natural variations from human-influenced changes.

Working with Hydro-Québec, the team set out to assess the impact of hydroelectric reservoirs on the carbon cycle compared with natural variations. Partial results have been published in the journal Environmental Research Letters .

"Many studies have focused on the long term or the industrial era, but we wanted to compare the evolution of accumulation rates in lake sediments over the past 11,000 years with trends over the last 150 years," explained Aude Flamand, a member of the research team.

To do so, the researchers relied on existing data. "We had neither the time nor the funds to collect new data in the field, but there is a wealth of data already available that we were able to use," Flamand said.

The existing data were incomplete, as they mostly came from studies that weren't focused on carbon accumulation, but they often contained at least two of the three variables—sediment density, percentage carbon content and dating—needed to calculate carbon accumulation. The team therefore developed a predictive model that links sediment density to organic matter content and is specifically adapted to the wide variety of boreal and temperate lake sediments.

"The existing models were not suited to boreal lakes, which generally contain very high levels of organic matter," Flamand said.

The disparate data sources presented numerous challenges. For one thing, the dating methods varied—radiocarbon for the oldest samples and lead-210 for the more recent ones.

"Two dating methods are rarely used on the same core," Lapierre explained. "It makes it difficult to compare accumulation rates across centuries and millennia."

While there have been significant climatic disruptions at various points during the Holocene, the most pronounced changes in accumulation rates occurred in recent centuries. "It seems that the arrival of the first settlers already disrupted accumulation rates, but starting in 1850, with the beginnings of industrialization, the variations intensified," Lapierre said.

In some lakes, sporadic decreases in carbon accumulation rates were found. "We expected an increase in accumulation rates, and not necessarily an increase in variability," Lapierre said.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 湖泊在捕获和储存碳（沉积物中积累的碳）方面发挥着重要作用。但随着时间的推移，它们可以吸收的量发生了很大变化。蒙特利尔大学生物科学系教授让-弗朗索瓦·拉皮埃尔 (Jean-François Lapierre) 是一个研究小组的成员，该研究小组致力于区分自然变化和人类影响的变化。 该团队与魁北克水电公司合作，着手评估水力发电水库与自然变化相比对碳循环的影响。部分结果已发表在《环境研究快报》杂志上。 “许多研究都集中在长期或工业时代，但我们希望将过去 11,000 年湖泊沉积物积累速率的演变与过去 150 年的趋势进行比较，”研究小组成员奥德·弗拉芒 (Aude Flamand) 解释道。 为此，研究人员依赖现有数据。 “我们既没有时间也没有资金在现场收集新数据，但我们可以使用大量已有的数据，”弗拉芒说。 现有数据并不完整，因为它们大多来自不关注碳积累的研究，但它们通常至少包含计算碳积累所需的三个变量中的两个——沉积物密度、碳含量百分比和年代测定。因此，该团队开发了一种预测模型，将沉积物密度与有机物含量联系起来，并且专门适用于各种北方和温带湖泊沉积物。 “现有模型不适合北方湖泊，因为北方湖泊通常含有非常高水平的有机物，”弗拉芒德说。 不同的数据源带来了许多挑战。一方面，测年方法各不相同——放射性碳用于最古老的样本，铅 210 用于较新的样本。 拉皮埃尔解释说：“在同一个岩心上很少使用两种测年方法。” “这使得比较几个世纪和几千年的积累率变得困难。” 尽管全新世期间的不同时期都出现过严重的气候破坏，但积累率最显着的变化发生在近几个世纪。拉皮埃尔说：“第一批定居者的到来似乎已经扰乱了积累率，但从 1850 年开始，随着工业化的开始，这种变化加剧了。” 在一些湖泊中，碳积累率出现零星下降。拉皮埃尔说：“我们预计积累率会增加，但变异性不一定会增加。” “这意味着湖泊对......变得更加敏感。

summary.en: A research team from Tel Aviv University and the Leibniz Institute of Polymer Research Dresden (IPF), led by Ayala Lampel and Carsten Werner, has developed a peptide-glycosaminoglycan hydrogel system that creates a programmable niche for hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells...

body.en: A research team from Tel Aviv University and the Leibniz Institute of Polymer Research Dresden (IPF), led by Ayala Lampel and Carsten Werner, has developed a peptide-glycosaminoglycan hydrogel system that creates a programmable niche for hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs). The system mimics key biochemical and mechanical cues of the bone marrow microenvironment, enabling researchers to investigate how these signals influence stem cell behavior.

title.en: CanopyFit maps urban tree sites with greatest cooling potential
title.zh: CanopyFit 绘制了具有最大冷却潜力的城市树木地点

summary.en: UBC researchers and municipal partners have developed a modeling tool to help cities adapt to rising temperatures by mapping where new trees offer the greatest cooling impact.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

UBC researchers and municipal partners have developed a modeling tool to help cities adapt to rising temperatures by mapping where new trees offer the greatest cooling impact.

First piloted in Kelowna and now expanding to Vancouver, CanopyFit accounts for urban constraints like underground utilities, overhead wires and infrastructure that often hinder planting.

"Creating and sustaining extensive canopy cover , by protecting mature trees and planting trees that can grow to large sizes, is one of the most effective investments cities can make to reduce exposure to extreme heat," said Dr. Melissa McHale, a professor in UBC's faculty of forestry and environmental stewardship and lead of the Urban Ecology and Sustainability Lab. "The challenge is making space for those trees and helping them thrive where they're needed most."

"A site can look empty on a map and still be impossible to plant," said McHale. "CanopyFit accounts for the hidden barriers that determine where trees can realistically go and how large they can grow."

By combining CanopyFit data with heat maps, shade models and demographic data, researchers can pinpoint priority zones. In Kelowna, the team identified neighborhoods like Rutland as high priorities for heat relief and equity, while others, like Midtown, faced significant constraints despite high cooling needs.

"Trees are no less important there—overcoming barriers, choosing suitable species and investing in long-term care may just require more resources," said McHale.

The analysis found that about half of Kelowna's new-canopy potential was concentrated in roughly 20% of its highest-opportunity planting sites, suggesting cities can maximize limited budgets by targeting areas where cooling benefits and planting opportunities align.

The team also used satellite imagery and machine learning to improve the city's heat map resolution from 30 meters to 10 meters, helping planners pinpoint exact locations for cooling interventions.

Researchers found that every 10% increase in tree canopy can reduce mean radiant temperature—the heat people feel from their surroundings—by roughly 1°C. The work is published in the journal Urban Forestry & Urban Greening .

The UBC–Kelowna partnership began in 2022, developing tools for municipal planning needs.

"Our goal is to support the planting and long-term success of more trees across Kelowna, growing a stronger urban canopy for future generations," said Todd Cashin, urban forestry supervisor with Kelowna. "These partnerships are incredibly valuable because they allow us to accomplish so much more together than we could...

title.en: Island could protect 30% of waters in marine plan
title.zh: 岛屿可以保护海洋计划中30%的水域

summary.en: The proposal would give added protection to about 50 sq miles (128.8 sq km) of sea around Sark.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
An island could protect 30% of its waters under plans aimed at safeguarding marine life.

The proposal would see about 50 sq miles (128.8 sq km) of sea around Sark in the Channel Islands receive additional protection under plans developed by the island's agriculture, environment and sea fisheries committee with support from the Blue Marine Foundation, local fishermen and marine experts.

Freddie Watson, Channel Islands project manager at Blue Marine Foundation, said marine protection could help safeguard sensitive habitats while supporting sustainable fishing.

The proposal has to be submitted by the committee to governing body Chief Pleas for approval.

Watson explained that evidence had been used to identify important habitats, including previously unmapped areas of seagrass, so protection could be focused where it was needed most.

The waters around Sark are home to species including European spiny lobster, rays, catsharks, octopus and pink sea fans.

Watson said the plans formed part of a wider effort across the Channel Islands to safeguard marine environments, including a plan to protect more than 20% of Jersey's waters .

Watson said stronger protection could bring benefits for both wildlife and people by helping to sustain fish stocks and preserve habitats that support marine biodiversity.

He added: "Some of those habitats are really important at drawing down and locking away carbon."

title.en: Scientists may have found a shortcut to calorie restriction’s anti-aging benefits
title.zh: 科学家可能已经找到了限制热量抗衰老的捷径

summary.en: Moderate calorie restriction lowered an immune protein called C3 that appears to help drive chronic inflammation as the body ages. Blocking the same protein reduced age related inflammation in mice, raising the possibility that future treatments could mimic some benefits of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Reducing calorie intake has extended lifespan in animals including mice, rhesus monkeys, and fruit flies. In some studies, the animals also remained healthier for longer. But severe calorie restriction can come with serious costs. Mice placed on a diet with 40% fewer calories, for instance, become more vulnerable to infections, reproduce less successfully, and show impaired growth.

That has left scientists with a difficult question: Could humans gain some of the longevity benefits of calorie restriction without experiencing those harmful effects? A new study, published in Nature Aging , points to a possible answer involving an immune protein called complement component 3 (C3).

Yale researchers have previously shown that people who followed moderate calorie restriction, cutting calorie intake by 14% for two years, developed stronger immune defenses without experiencing problems related to growth or reproduction.

"This concept demonstrates that aging is actually malleable and a process that can be targeted," says senior author Vishwa Deep Dixit, PhD, Waldemar Von Zedtwitz Professor of Pathology, professor of immunobiology and of comparative medicine, and director of the Yale Center for Research on Aging (Y-Age) at Yale School of Medicine.

For the new study, Dixit and his colleagues at YSM examined plasma samples from 42 people who participated in a National Institutes of Health-funded two-year study called the Comprehensive Assessment of Long-Term Effects of Reducing Intake of Energy or CALERIE.

"It's the only trial of its kind that has been done with such rigor and control and demonstrates relevance to human physiology," Dixit says. During the trial, participants reduced their calorie intake by 11 to 14% without feeling deprived.

The researchers measured more than 7,000 proteins across plasma samples collected over time. One stood out: complement component 3 (C3), an immune protein whose levels fell significantly after calorie restriction.

C3 drew particular attention because earlier research has suggested that activation of the complement system, a network of proteins that helps defend the body against pathogens, may contribute to chronic inflammation. That persistent inflammation is considered a major feature of aging and many age-associated diseases.

"But the causal effects of C3 in aging and chronic inflammation have not been identified. So, we were very excited to find that in our study," says Hee-Hoon Kim, PhD, a postdoctoral associate in the Dixit lab and a co-first author of the paper.

By comparing protein levels before and after two years of calorie restriction, the team found that white adipose tissue, the main form of fat tissue in mammals, appeared to be the primary tissue affected by the dietary change.

title.en: 190-year-old DNA reveals a hidden pangolin species

summary.en: DNA from a nearly 190-year-old museum specimen has helped scientists confirm a distinct Himalayan pangolin species hiding in plain sight in Nepal and northern India. The discovery could give conservationists a powerful new way to trace illegally traded pangolin scales back to...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Pangolins look almost prehistoric. These medium-sized mammals, found only in Africa and Asia, have long, powerful tails, large curved claws, and bodies covered in overlapping scales that resemble a pinecone. Those distinctive scales are also a major reason pangolins are in danger. They are heavily targeted by poachers and are considered the most highly trafficked mammals in the world, leaving many species at serious risk of extinction.

Now, researchers have confirmed that a previously unrecognized Asian pangolin species, Manis aurita , has been living in Nepal and Northern India. The findings, published in Communications Biology , clarify how different pangolin species are related, where they live, and how they can be distinguished. That information could also help authorities identify where illegally traded pangolins are being hunted and strengthen efforts to stop poaching.

"We can't protect what we do not know, and now that we have confirmed that this other species of pangolin exists, we can use that information to help protect these endangered animals," says Anderson Feijó, the Negaunee Assistant Curator of Mammals at the Field Museum and co-corresponding author of the study.

"This finding marks the culmination of more than five years of research that began in Nepal, where we first documented evidence suggesting that Himalayan pangolins represented a distinct evolutionary lineage," says Narayan Koju, a researcher at the Nepal Engineering College at Pokhara University and the study's first author. "The confirmation of Manis aurita as a valid species demonstrates the importance of long-term research, international collaboration, and museum collections. Most importantly, it provides a strong scientific basis for conservation planning, wildlife forensics, and efforts to protect one of the world's most trafficked mammals from extinction."

The classification of these Himalayan pangolins had already begun to change in 2025. That year, another research team determined that animals previously grouped together as Chinese pangolins actually represented two species. One occurs mainly in China, while the other inhabits the Himalayan foothills across parts of Nepal, India, Bhutan, and Myanmar. The researchers named the mountain-dwelling form Manis indoburmanica , or the Indo-Burmese pangolin.

But scientific naming follows a rule of priority: when the same species has been given more than one scientific name, the earliest valid name takes precedence.

At the time, Feijó and his colleagues were already conducting a decade-long investigation into pangolin evolution. Their work combined DNA evidence with physical characteristics to determine how many pangolin species exist and how those species are related.

body.zh: 穿山甲看起来几乎是史前的。这些中型哺乳动物仅在非洲和亚洲发现，它们有长而有力的尾巴、大而弯曲的爪子，身体上覆盖着类似松果的重叠鳞片。这些独特的鳞片也是穿山甲面临危险的一个主要原因。它们是偷猎者的重点目标，被认为是世界上贩运最频繁的哺乳动物，使许多物种面临严重的灭绝风险。 现在，研究人员证实，一种以前未被识别的亚洲穿山甲物种——Manis aurita，一直生活在尼泊尔和印度北部。发表在《通讯生物学》上的研究结果阐明了不同穿山甲物种之间的关系、它们的生活地点以及如何区分它们。这些信息还可以帮助当局确定非法交易的穿山甲在哪里被猎杀，并加强制止偷猎的力度。 “我们无法保护我们不知道的东西，现在我们已经确认了这种其他穿山甲物种的存在，我们可以利用这些信息来帮助保护这些濒临灭绝的动物，”菲尔德博物馆内高尼哺乳动物馆助理馆长、该研究的共同通讯作者安德森·费约 (Anderson Feijó) 说。 博卡拉大学尼泊尔工程学院研究员、该研究的第一作者 Narayan Koju 表示：“这一发现标志着在尼泊尔开始的五年多研究的高潮，我们在那里首次记录了表明喜马拉雅穿山甲代表着独特进化谱系的证据。” “确认玛尼斯 aurita 为有效物种表明了长期研究、国际合作和博物馆收藏的重要性。最重要的是，它为保护规划、野生动物取证以及保护世界上贩运最多的哺乳动物之一免遭灭绝的努力提供了坚实的科学基础。” 2025年，这些喜马拉雅穿山甲的分类已经开始发生变化。那一年，另一个研究小组确定，之前被归为中华穿山甲的动物实际上代表两个物种。一种主要发生在中国，另一种则栖息在尼泊尔、印度、不丹和缅甸部分地区的喜马拉雅山麓。研究人员将这种山地穿山甲命名为“Manis indoburmanica”，即印缅穿山甲。 但科学命名遵循优先规则：当同一物种被赋予多个科学名称时，最早的有效名称优先。 当时，费乔和他的同事已经对穿山甲的进化进行了长达十年的研究。他们的工作将 DNA 证据与物理特征相结合，以确定穿山甲物种的存在数量以及这些物种之间的关系。 在那项研究期间，他们...

title.en: Manhattan-sized ice island breaks off Greenland’s Petermann Glacier
title.zh: 曼哈顿大小的冰岛从格陵兰岛的彼得曼冰川上脱落

summary.en: A Manhattan-sized ice island has broken away from Greenland’s Petermann Glacier after years of growing fractures weakened its floating ice tongue. Scientists expect two more huge sections could soon detach, potentially removing about 22 percent of the remaining ice tongue.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
An international team of researchers, led in part by the University of Ottawa, has documented a major calving event at Petermann Glacier in northwest Greenland. On August 4, 2026, the glacier released a 76.4 km 2 ice island, its largest loss of floating ice since 2012 and the biggest Arctic calving event since 2020.

The newly separated tabular iceberg broke away from Petermann Glacier's floating ice tongue and may be as much as 150 meters thick. Its surface area is roughly comparable to Manhattan Island, giving scientists a rare opportunity to observe how enormous Arctic ice masses develop, move through the ocean and eventually fragment.

The event was identified by Adam Garbo, a PhD student in glaciology at uOttawa's Department of Geography, Environment and Geomatics. The discovery is part of an ongoing collaboration involving the University of Ottawa, the University of Stirling, Environment and Climate Change Canada, Lancaster University, and the University of Leeds.

Scientists have been tracking changes at Petermann Glacier with long-term satellite observations since 2019. Over that period, they closely followed the condition of the glacier's floating ice tongue, recording the expansion of fractures and watching for signs that a major section might eventually break away.

"Petermann Glacier has long been one of Greenland's largest remaining ice tongues," says Garbo. "We've anticipated this break for years, and seeing it finally happen is remarkable."

Images collected by the European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 mission showed clear signs of deterioration along the centerline of the ice tongue on August 3. By 20:00 UTC on August 4, the new ice island had fully separated from the glacier's eastern side.

Large, flat-topped icebergs are relatively common around Antarctica, but comparable ice islands are much less frequently seen in the Arctic. Their rarity and longevity make them especially valuable to researchers studying glacier retreat, changing ocean conditions and the risks posed by drifting ice in polar regions.

"While large, tabular icebergs are relatively common in the Southern Ocean that surrounds the Antarctic Ice Sheet, Arctic ice islands are far rarer," explains Dr. Anna Crawford of the University of Stirling. "By studying Arctic ice islands, we will gain knowledge that can be transferred across Polar regions."

Scientists do not expect the August calving event to be the last major change at Petermann Glacier. Two additional large sections of the floating ice tongue are expected to detach in the near future as rifts that have been developing for years continue to cut through the ice.

Those future ice islands are projected to measure about 94 km 2 and 84 km 2 . If both break away, the three calving events combined would remove...
body.zh: 由渥太华大学部分领导的一个国际研究小组记录了格陵兰岛西北部彼得曼冰川的一次重大冰崩事件。 2026年8月4日，冰川释放出一座76.4 km 2 的冰岛，这是自2012年以来最大的浮冰损失，也是自2020年以来最大的北极崩解事件。 新分离出来的板状冰山从彼得曼冰川的漂浮冰舌中脱离出来，厚度可能高达150米。它的表面积与曼哈顿岛大致相当，为科学家提供了难得的机会来观察巨大的北极冰块如何形成、穿过海洋并最终破碎。 这一事件是由渥太华大学地理、环境和地理信息系冰川学博士生 Adam Garbo 发现的。这一发现是渥太华大学、斯特灵大学、加拿大环境与气候变化大学、兰卡斯特大学和利兹大学正在进行的合作的一部分。 自2019年以来，科学家们一直通过长期卫星观测来追踪彼得曼冰川的变化。在此期间，他们密切关注冰川漂浮冰舌的状况，记录裂缝的扩张情况，并观察主要部分可能最终破裂的迹象。 “彼得曼冰川长期以来一直是格陵兰岛现存最大的冰舌之一，”嘉宝说。 “我们多年来一直期待这种突破，看到它最终发生真是太了不起了。” 8 月 3 日，欧洲航天局 Sentinel-1 任务收集的图像显示，冰舌中心线有明显恶化迹象。到 8 月 4 日 20:00 UTC，新冰岛已与冰川东侧完全分离。 大型平顶冰山在南极洲周围相对常见，但类似的冰岛在北极却很少见。它们的稀有性和寿命使其对于研究冰川退缩、海洋条件变化以及极地地区流冰带来的风险的研究人员特别有价值。 斯特灵大学的安娜·克劳福德博士解释说：“虽然在南极冰盖周围的南大洋中，大型板状冰山相对常见，但北极的冰岛却要少得多。” “通过研究北极冰岛，我们将获得可以跨极地地区传播的知识。” 科学家们预计八月的崩解事件不会是彼得曼冰川的最后一次重大变化。随着多年来不断形成的裂痕继续切割冰层，预计浮冰舌的另外两大部分将在不久的将来分离。 这些未来的冰岛预计面积约为 94 km 2 和 84 km 2 。如果两者都脱离，这三个产犊事件加在一起将消除......

title.en: Mpox is back – and in new countries. How can this outbreak be contained?

summary.en: A new outbreak of mpox has reached Guinea Bissau for the first time, marking a resurgence of the virus that has affected 145 countries since 2022. Health officials are particularly concerned as the latest cases show that children are being disproportionately impacted by the infection.
summary.zh: 几内亚比绍首次出现猴痘疫情，标志着自2022年以来已波及145个国家的该病毒再次引发关注。卫生官员特别担心，最新病例显示儿童受感染的影响尤为严重。

body.en: The public health emergencies in 2022 and 2024 saw the virus reported in 145 countries, but in the new cases children appear particularly affected A fresh outbreak of mpox in Guinea Bissau – the country’s first – means the virus formerly known as monkey pox is back in the headlines. So what has changed? Since 2022, there have been almost 190,000 lab-confirmed cases of mpox reported worldwide in 145 countries. Before then, outbreaks of mpox tended to be relatively small and in a handful of African countries, where the viral infection was known to be endemic. Continue reading...

As the global community seeks medical solutions to contain the spread, we are called to remember the sick in our prayers and support efforts that protect the most fragile among us. In every...
reflection.zh: 猴痘疫情的卷土重来，特别是对几内亚比绍等地儿童的影响，提醒我们人类共同的脆弱性以及关爱受苦者的责任。在全球社会寻求医疗方案以遏制病毒传播的同时，我们受召在祷告中纪念病患，并支持保护最弱势群体的努力。在每一次健康危机中，怜悯的呼唤始终是面对恐惧时的一盏明灯，我们要相信雅伟垂听受苦者的哀求。

title.en: Off-roaders caught damaging protected site after posting videos to TikTok
title.zh: 越野者在 TikTok 上发布视频后发现破坏受保护的网站

summary.en: Three men were convicted for their part in driving in a convoy from Liverpool to Berwyn SSSI.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Three men have been convicted after videos of them using off-road vehicles to cause "irreversible" harm to a protected area were posted to TikTok.

John Robinson, Michael Williams and Joseph Hodgson were part of a convoy that drove the vehicles from Liverpool to the Berwyn Site of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI), Denbighshire.

Robinson and Williams were fined more than £2,000 each and disqualified from driving for two months, while Hodgson did not attend court but was found guilty of criminal damage in his absence.

Kirsty Roberts, from Natural Resources Wales (NRW), said SSSIs were protected because they "support the UK's most important" and fragile wildlife.

Wrexham Magistrates' Court heard on Thursday that seven 4x4 vehicles travelled to Berwyn SSSI, a protected site under the Wildlife and Countryside Act , external , from Liverpool on 1 June 2025.

NRW said the vehicles travelled over private land to the Moel Fferna peak, leaving "huge tyre marks and damage" in peat and blanket bog habitats, both of which are "rare and protected".

A gate lock was broken with bolt croppers, NRW said, and signs were "torn down" to enable the vehicles to gain access, despite "clear signage" stating that private vehicles were not permitted.

TikTok accounts linked to the group showed images and videos of them at the site causing "serious damage" to the peat and bog habitat and "leaving deep tracks when entering the blanket bog".

The social media content also showed that two of the vehicles had to be towed by the group after becoming stuck, causing further harm to the environment.

NRW classified the most serious damage as a Category 2 impact, defined as "significant harm to an SSSI habitat, with deep ruts causing long-term, irreversible hydrological damage that limits natural recovery".

SSSIs are legally protected because they contain special features, including threatened habitats, rare and endangered species or important geology.

As well as hosting large areas of blanket bog, a rare type of peatland, Berwyn SSSI is also an important upland area for breeding birds and supports species including black grouse and curlew.

Robinson pleaded guilty to criminal damage and Williams accepted damaging the ancient peat and blanket bog site at an earlier hearing.

The court heard Hodgson, who failed to attend court, had previously accepted he had caused damage to the site. A warrant has been issued for his arrest to bring him to court to be sentenced.

"Once it is cut up by deep ruts, the water balance can be altered for years degrading habitat and reducing carbon storage," she said.

body.zh: 三名男子使用越野车对保护区造成“不可逆转”伤害的视频被发布到 TikTok 后被定罪。 约翰·罗宾逊 (John Robinson)、迈克尔·威廉姆斯 (Michael Williams) 和约瑟夫·霍奇森 (Joseph Hodgson) 是车队的成员，将车辆从利物浦开往登比郡伯温特殊科学价值遗址 (SSSI)。 罗宾逊和威廉姆斯分别被罚款超过 2,000 英镑，并被取消两个月驾驶资格，而霍奇森没有出庭，但因缺席而被判犯有刑事损害罪。 来自威尔士自然资源部 (NRW) 的柯斯蒂·罗伯茨 (Kirsty Roberts) 表示，SSSI 受到保护，因为它们“支持着英国最重要的”和脆弱的野生动物。 雷克瑟姆地方法院周四获悉，2025 年 6 月 1 日，有 7 辆 4x4 车辆从利物浦前往 Berwyn SSSI，这是根据《野生动物和乡村法案》外部的受保护地点。 北威州表示，这些车辆经过私人土地前往莫埃尔费纳峰，在泥炭和毯状沼泽栖息地留下“巨大的轮胎痕迹和损坏”，这两个地方都是“稀有且受保护的”。 北威州表示，一处门锁被螺栓剪坏了，尽管有“明确的标牌”表明私人车辆不允许通行，但标志牌仍被“撕毁”以使车辆能够进入。 与该组织相关的 TikTok 账户显示，他们在现场对泥炭和沼泽栖息地造成“严重破坏”，并“在进入毯状沼泽时留下深深的痕迹”。 社交媒体内容还显示，其中两辆车被困后不得不被该团体拖走，对环境造成进一步危害。 北威州将最严重的损害归为第 2 类影响，定义为“对 SSSI 栖息地造成重大损害，深深的车辙造成长期、不可逆转的水文损害，限制了自然恢复”。 SSSI 受到法律保护，因为它们具有特殊特征，包括受威胁的栖息地、稀有和濒危物种或重要的地质。 伯温 SSSI 不仅拥有大面积的毯状沼泽（一种罕见的泥炭地），也是鸟类繁殖的重要高地地区，也是黑松鸡和麻鹬等物种的栖息地。 罗宾逊承认犯有刑事破坏罪，威廉姆斯在早些时候的听证会上承认破坏了古老的泥炭和毯状沼泽地。 法庭获悉，霍奇森未能出庭，此前他承认自己对现场造成了损害。已发出逮捕令，将他带上法庭接受审判。 她说：“一旦被深深的车辙切断，水平衡就会改变数年，导致栖息地退化和碳储存减少。” “非法越野也会影响管理这些私人工作环境的农民和土地所有者，扰乱农业经营，增加成本，并损害长期......

title.en: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope is ready to hunt thousands of alien worlds
title.zh: 美国宇航局的罗马太空望远镜已准备好寻找数千个外星世界

summary.en: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope is now enclosed inside its Falcon Heavy fairing and nearly ready for launch. Its mission could uncover thousands of exoplanets while helping scientists investigate dark matter, dark energy, and the accelerating expansion of the universe.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is now one major step closer to liftoff. On Aug. 21, teams enclosed the observatory inside the protective fairing of its SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket at the Payload Hazardous Servicing Facility at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

The fairing is the large shell that surrounds a spacecraft at the top of a rocket. Standing 43 feet tall, it protects Roman while the observatory is on the ground and during the most violent early stages of launch. Together with specialized ground support equipment, the fairing also keeps the telescope in a controlled environment as teams move it between facilities.

Launch exposes spacecraft to extreme conditions. As Falcon Heavy accelerates through Earth's atmosphere, Roman will experience powerful sound waves, aerodynamic pressure, and significant heating. The fairing is designed to shield the observatory from those stresses.

Once the rocket climbs high enough that the surrounding atmosphere is no longer a threat, the fairing will no longer be needed. A few minutes after liftoff, its two halves will separate and fall away, allowing Roman to continue its journey into space. SpaceX plans to recover both fairing sections after they return to Earth.

Roman will ultimately travel toward Sun-Earth Lagrange point 2 (L2), a location in space where the gravitational influence of the Sun and Earth helps spacecraft maintain a relatively stable position. This region is especially useful for powerful space observatories because it provides a favorable environment for continuously observing the universe.

Before launch, teams will transport the encapsulated Roman observatory to SpaceX's hangar at Launch Pad 39A. There, the payload will be attached to the Falcon Heavy rocket.

The fully assembled vehicle will then be moved to the launch pad at Launch Complex 39A. NASA and SpaceX are targeting no earlier than 7:26 a.m. EDT Sunday, Aug. 30, for liftoff.

Once Roman begins science operations, researchers expect it to discover thousands of exoplanets, which are planets orbiting stars beyond our solar system. Studying such a large population could help astronomers determine how common different types of planetary systems are and whether some distant worlds resemble planets closer to home.

Roman will also investigate two of the biggest mysteries in modern cosmology: dark matter and dark energy. Dark matter cannot be seen directly, but its gravity appears to shape galaxies and large cosmic structures. Dark energy is the name scientists use for whatever is driving the universe to expand at an accelerating rate.

By surveying huge areas of the sky and tracking how matter and galaxies are distributed across the cosmos, Roman could give researchers new clues about both phenomena. Its observations...
body.zh: 美国宇航局的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜现在离升空又近了一大步。 8 月 21 日，团队将天文台封闭在位于佛罗里达州 NASA 肯尼迪航天中心有效载荷危险维修设施的 SpaceX 猎鹰重型火箭的保护性整流罩内。 整流罩是火箭顶部围绕航天器的大型外壳。它高 43 英尺，在天文台位于地面时以及在发射过程中最激烈的早期阶段为罗曼提供保护。与专门的地面支持设备一起，当团队在设施之间移动望远镜时，整流罩还可以将望远镜保持在受控环境中。 发射使航天器暴露在极端条件下。当猎鹰重型火箭加速穿过地球大气层时，罗曼将经历强大的声波、空气动力压力和显着的热量。整流罩旨在保护天文台免受这些压力。 一旦火箭爬升到足够高，周围的大气不再构成威胁，就不再需要整流罩。升空几分钟后，它的两半将分离并脱落，让罗曼继续其太空之旅。 SpaceX 计划在返回地球后回收两个整流罩部分。 罗曼最终将前往太阳-地球拉格朗日点 2 (L2)，该位置是太空中太阳和地球引力影响帮助航天器保持相对稳定位置的位置。该区域对于强大的太空观测站特别有用，因为它为持续观测宇宙提供了有利的环境。 发射前，团队会将封装的罗马天文台运送到 SpaceX 位于 39A 发射台的机库。在那里，有效载荷将被附加到猎鹰重型火箭上。 完全组装好的车辆随后将被移至 39A 发射场的发射台。 NASA 和 SpaceX 的目标是不早于美国东部时间 8 月 30 日星期日上午 7 点 26 分升空。 一旦罗马开始科学行动，研究人员预计它将发现数千颗系外行星，这些行星是围绕太阳系之外的恒星运行的行星。研究如此庞大的人口可以帮助天文学家确定不同类型的行星系统的常见程度，以及一些遥远的世界是否类似于离地球较近的行星。 罗曼还将调查现代宇宙学中两个最大的谜团：暗物质和暗能量。暗物质无法直接看到，但它的引力似乎塑造了星系和大型宇宙结构。暗能量是科学家用来描述推动宇宙加速膨胀的物质的名称。 通过测量大片天空并跟踪物质和星系在宇宙中的分布情况，罗曼可以为研究人员提供有关这两种现象的新线索。它的观察...

title.en: Yellow warnings remain in force as rain and thunderstorms hit parts of UK
title.zh: 由于降雨和雷暴袭击英国部分地区，黄色预警仍然有效

summary.en: Yellow warnings updated as torrential downpours affect parts of England and Wales, delivering some of the wettest weather in several weeks.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Downpours and thunderstorms will continue to bring the risk of flooding to parts of the UK on Wednesday.

A Met Office yellow warning for thunderstorms is valid until 22:00 BST, and was amended on Wednesday morning to cover northern and eastern Wales, as well as north-west England, the Midlands and parts of eastern and southern England.

The rain could be heavy enough to bring flash flooding and travel disruption, with lightning and large hail posing additional hazards.

Another Met Office yellow warning is in place for Thursday, when more thunderstorms are expected.

For some areas that have seen barely any rain so far this August, the next few days could bring the wettest weather in many weeks.

The Met Office yellow thunderstorm warning covers a large swathe of England and Wales.

As much as 20-30mm (0.8-1.2in) of rain could fall in some locations within just an hour, and it is even possible that 40-50mm (1.6-2in) could accumulate over a few hours.

However, due to the hit-and-miss nature of showers, some places will miss the rain and weather apps may struggle to get the detail of the forecast correct.

Where the rain does fall, flash flooding is a real concern. This will be especially problematic where the ground is hard after the prolonged dry spell, making it difficult for the water to soak in.

Difficult driving conditions are expected with the chance that some roads could be closed.

Northern Ireland will also see some showers but these are likely to be less intense with less thunder.

Many parts of Scotland will remain dry with sunny spells, although some showers are likely in the south-west later.

Thursday will bring another zone of thunderstorms, again affecting mostly England and Wales.

The Met Office has issued a further yellow weather warning, valid from 06:00 until 22:00 BST.

Widespread rainfall totals of 20-30mm (0.8-1.2in) are expected in the warning area within three hours, while some areas could see 50mm (2in) within the same timeframe.

There is a small chance that eastern-facing hills - exposed to easterly winds - could record 75mm (3in) during 12 hours, which would bring a significant flood risk.

Gusty winds may also accompany the storms, especially in southern England on Thursday morning.

The showers may eventually reach southern Scotland and Northern Ireland but are likely to weaken and become less intense as they drift northwards.

Despite a period of unsettled weather last week, some southern parts of the UK have still seen barely any rain recently.

Brize Norton in Oxfordshire has recorded just 0.4mm of rain so far this August, less than 1% of what it would normally expect during the month as a whole.

It means the rain we are expecting this week is likely to far outstrip what has fallen recently in some areas.

title.en: Things are getting worse, says litter picker
title.zh: 捡垃圾的人说情况变得更糟

summary.en: An anti-litter campaigner visits all 39 BBC local radio stations with her message.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
An 81-year-old anti-littering campaigner has travelled across the country encouraging people to pick up rubbish rather than dropping it.

Ruth Major, from Redruth, Cornwall visited all 39 BBC radio stations in England across 55 days armed with a litter picker and a bus pass.

Affectionately known as Rubbish Ruth, she has collected litter for 10 years and said "things are getting worse".

"We live in a beautiful country and we should be so ashamed of what's happening in it," she said.
body.zh: 一位 81 岁的反乱扔垃圾活动家走遍全国，鼓励人们捡起垃圾，而不是乱扔垃圾。 来自康沃尔郡雷德鲁斯的露丝·梅杰 (Ruth Major) 在 55 天内参观了英格兰所有 39 个 BBC 广播电台，并携带垃圾收集器和公交车通行证。 她被亲切地称为“垃圾露丝”，她已经收集垃圾10年了，她说“事情变得越来越糟”。 “我们生活在一个美丽的国家，我们应该为那里发生的事情感到羞耻，”她说。

title.en: One asteroid strike may explain two mysteries of Mars’ moon Deimos
title.zh: 一次小行星撞击可能解释火星卫星火卫二的两个谜团

summary.en: A single asteroid impact may explain two of Deimos’s most puzzling features: its huge southern depression and unusually smooth, dusty surface. Simulations suggest a roughly 320-meter asteroid struck the Martian moon at an angle, throwing debris around the entire world without...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A single asteroid impact may explain two of Deimos’s most puzzling features: its huge southern depression and unusually smooth, dusty surface. Simulations suggest a roughly 320-meter asteroid struck the Martian moon at an angle, throwing debris around the entire world without breaking it apart. New observations from ESA’s Hera spacecraft support the scenario and indicate that Deimos is surprisingly porous and fragile.
body.zh: 一次小行星撞击或许可以解释火卫二最令人费解的两个特征：巨大的南部洼地和异常光滑、布满灰尘的表面。模拟显示，一颗大约 320 米长的小行星以一定角度撞击了火星卫星，将碎片抛向整个世界，但没有将其击碎。欧空局赫拉航天器的新观测结果支持了这一假设，并表明火卫二出人意料地多孔且脆弱。

title.en: RSPB reports record-breaking chough numbers
title.zh: RSPB报告鹪鹩数量创纪录

summary.en: RSPB England reports a record 161 choughs counted, an increase of 32 from the 129 recorded last year. These birds, which had died out in Cornwall in the 1970s and returned in 2001, are now thriving due to successful breeding and inter-agency cooperation.
summary.zh: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会（RSPB）报告称，今年夏天在康沃尔海岸线上筑巢的鹪鹩数量创下纪录，共有161只，比去年的129只增加了32只。该鸟类在20世纪70年代在康沃尔灭绝，于2001年回归。今年的成功归功于56个繁殖对的努力以及各机构、农民和地主的合作。

body.en:
A record-breaking number of choughs have made their nests around the Cornish coastline this summer, proving the breed is in "robust health", a bird conservation charity has said.

RSPB England said 161 choughs had been counted in Cornwall - 32 more than the 129 recorded in 2025 .

The charity said the new birds came from 56 successful breeding pairs, meaning the average productivity of a Cornish chough nest was three fledglings.

It said choughs died out in Cornwall in the 1970s but returned in 2001 when three birds believed to be from Ireland landed at Lizard Point and began rebreeding. The National Trust added the success had been down to cooperation between agencies, farmers and landowners.

The birds, part of the carrion crow family, have a particular significance in Cornwall, featuring on the county's official coat of arms, alongside a miner and a fisherman.

Peter Hall, a National Trust chough monitoring volunteer on the Lizard, is in his 11th year of monitoring the nest sites.

He said he had not foreseen a time when he would be monitoring so many sites -"certainly not having 16 choughlets fledge".

Hall said: "The past two winters we have been blessed with chatterings in excess of 20 chough around the Lizard - a far cry from the solitary single pair we had when I started as part of the then nest protection team in 2016.

"Long may the successful return of this iconic Cornish bird delight myself and others."

The charity said the Lizard was the prime breeding ground for the Cornish chough, with 26 chicks, 11 more than 2025, emerging from eight nests on the peninsula.

National Trust volunteer Lydia Allt said 2026 had been "an exceptional one" for choughs on the Lizard and across Cornwall.

She said: "Thanks to a quarter of a century of conservation work, partnership working and the support of local farmers and land managers, we are seeing record numbers ofchough across the area.

"Their remarkable recovery shows what can be achieved when habitats are restored and protected, giving wildlife the space it needs to thrive.

"To see so many choughs successfully breeding and feeding across the Lizard is incredibly encouraging and highlights the importance of continuing to care for this special landscape for future generations."

Andrew Jones, chough conservation officer for the RSPB in Cornwall, said the repopulation work would not be possible without volunteers.

He said: "There has been a huge volunteer effort over the past 25 years to protect and monitor Cornwall's iconic choughs and we're grateful to everyone who has played their part in this conservation success story.

"This year, the RSPB and National Trust have had a team of around 50 dedicated volunteer chough watchers, covering the coastline from the Roseland all the way round to Bude,...
body.zh: 一家鸟类保护慈善机构表示，今年夏天，康沃尔海岸线附近筑巢的山鸦数量打破了纪录，证明该品种处于“健康状态”。 英国皇家鸟类保护协会表示，康沃尔郡已统计到 161 只山鸦，比 2025 年记录的 129 只多了 32 只。 该慈善机构表示，这些新鸟来自 56 对成功繁殖的鸟，这意味着康沃尔山鸦巢的平均生产力为三只雏鸟。 报告称，康沃尔郡的山鸦于 1970 年代灭绝，但在 2001 年又回归，当时三只据信来自爱​​尔兰的鸟降落在 Lizard Point 并开始重新繁殖。国民信托补充说，成功归功于各机构、农民和土地所有者之间的合作。 这些鸟是腐肉乌鸦家族的一部分，在康沃尔郡具有特殊的意义，与矿工和渔夫一起出现在该县的官方徽章上。 彼得·霍尔 (Peter Hall) 是一名国家信托山鸦监测蜥蜴的志愿者，今年已经是他监测巢穴的第 11 个年头了。 他说，他没有预见到自己会监控如此多的地点——“当然没有 16 只小山雀羽翼未丰”。 霍尔说：“过去两个冬天，我们有幸看到超过 20 只山鸦在蜥蜴周围叽叽喳喳地叫个不停，这与我 2016 年加入当时的巢穴保护团队时看到的单独一对相去甚远。 “祝愿这只标志性的康沃尔鸟成功回归，让我和其他人感到高兴。” 该慈善机构表示，这种蜥蜴是康沃尔山鸦的主要繁殖地，半岛上的 8 个巢中共有 26 只雏鸟，比 2025 年增加了 11 只。 国家信托志愿者莉迪亚·奥尔特 (Lydia Allt) 表示，2026 年对于蜥蜴河和整个康沃尔郡的山鸦来说是“特殊的一年”。 她说：“由于四分之一个世纪的保护工作、合作伙伴关系以及当地农民和土地管理者的支持，我们看到该地区山鸦的数量创历史新高。 “它们的显着恢复表明，当栖息地得到恢复和保护，为野生动物提供繁衍生息所需的空间时，可以取得什么样的成就。 “看到如此多的山鸦成功地在蜥蜴身上繁殖和进食，真是令人鼓舞，也凸显了为子孙后代继续照顾这一特殊景观的重要性。” 康沃尔郡皇家鸟类保护协会的山鸦保护官员安德鲁·琼斯表示，如果没有志愿者，繁殖工作就不可能进行。 他说：“过去 25 年里，志愿者们为保护和监测康沃尔郡的标志性山鸦付出了巨大的努力，我们感谢所有在这一保护成功故事中做出贡献的人。 “今年，皇家鸟类保护协会和国家信托基金会组建了一支由约 50 名热忱的山鸦观察志愿者组成的团队，覆盖从罗斯兰一直到布德的海岸线，......

reflection.en: The resurgence of the chough in Cornwall is a hopeful sign of nature's resilience and the impact of dedicated conservation. It reminds us that even after periods of decline, life can flourish when efforts are made to protect and restore it, reflecting the goodness of creation.
reflection.zh: 鹪鹩在康沃尔的回归是自然生命力和保护工作成效的希望信号。这提醒我们，即使在经历衰退之后，只要我们努力保护和恢复，生命也能蓬勃发展，这反映了受造物的“甚好”。

title.en: Sand overextraction weakening riverbanks as concrete demand soars
title.zh: 沙子过度开采削弱河岸，混凝土需求激增

summary.en: Research indicates that the demand for sand and gravel has more than doubled since 2000, with 80% of current demand originating from Asia. This surge in demand, driven by concrete production for global construction projects, is leading to the extraction of these materials from riverbeds at a rate faster than natural...
summary.zh: 研究表明，自2000年以来，沙子和砾石的需求量增加了一倍多，目前80%的需求来自亚洲。由于混凝土生产对全球建筑项目的需求激增，这些材料正以比自然补充速度更快的速度从河床中提取。研究强调了其后果，包括河岸变弱、地下水位下降、沿海盐水入侵以及水质恶化。2024年，全球有280亿吨沙子和砾石被用于制造混凝土。

body.en: Research finds demand has more than doubled since 2000 and 80% of current demand comes from Asia A booming demand for concrete has resulted in sand and gravel being extracted from riverbeds faster than nature can replenish it. A study published in Reviews of Geophysics shows that the demand for sand and gravel has more than doubled in the last two decades, with overextraction leading to weaker riverbanks, lower groundwater levels, coastal salt intrusion and poorer water quality. In 2024, city-building and infrastructure projects around the world turned 28bn tonnes of sand and gravel into concrete. Researchers reviewed data on sand and gravel extraction going back to 1974 and have shown that since 2000 demand has more than doubled, with more than 80% of current demand coming from Asia, supporting urban development and road-building across China and India in particular. They found much of the material was being extracted from rivers across Asia and Africa. Data on extraction is scarce but where it does exist the researchers showed that extraction often exceeded natural sediment replacement severalfold. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，自 2000 年以来，需求量增加了一倍多，目前 80% 的需求来自亚洲。对混凝土的需求旺盛，导致从河床上提取沙子和砾石的速度超过了自然补充的速度。 《地球物理学评论》上发表的一项研究表明，过去二十年对沙子和砾石的需求增加了一倍多，过度开采导致河岸脆弱、地下水位降低、沿海盐分入侵和水质恶化。 2024 年，世界各地的城市建设和基础设施项目将 280 亿吨沙子和砾石转化为混凝土。研究人员回顾了自 1974 年以来的砂石开采数据，结果表明，自 2000 年以来，需求量增加了一倍多，目前 80% 以上的需求来自亚洲，支持着中国和印度的城市发展和道路建设。他们发现大部分材料是从亚洲和非洲的河流中提取的。有关提取的数据很少，但在确实存在的情况下，研究人员表明，提取量通常超过自然沉积物替代量的数倍。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless demand for construction materials, particularly sand and gravel, is straining the Earth's resources. This overextraction from riverbeds, as detailed in the research, disrupts natural systems and impacts water quality and stability. The Psalmist reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This perspective calls for...
reflection.zh: 对建筑材料，特别是沙子和砾石的无情需求，正在给地球的资源带来压力。正如研究中所详述的，从河床过度开采这些材料会破坏自然系统，并影响水质和稳定性。《诗篇》的作者提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，世界和其中所居住的，都属雅伟。”这一视角呼吁我们负责任地管理所托付给我们的资源，认识到它们的神圣起源和超越人类即时用途的内在价值。

verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Dogs blink more often when they see owners blinking, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现：狗狗看到主人眨眼时会更频繁地眨眼

summary.en: New research indicates that dogs increase their blinking rate when they observe their owners doing the same, suggesting that this behavior may have evolved a social function in human-dog interactions.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，当狗狗看到主人眨眼时，它们的眨眼频率会增加，这表明这种行为可能在人与狗的互动中演化出了社交功能。

body.en: Scientists say research suggests blinking may have acquired a social relevance in interactions between dogs and people Stare into a dog’s eyes and you may encounter a bemused expression. But researchers have found that dogs blink more often when they see their owners doing so, suggesting there may be more to the mutual gaze than meets the eye. Scientists have previously found that dogs turn on the puppy eyes when humans look at them, and that their brains can distinguish happy human faces from other expressions – even telling apart fearful faces from those that are angry or sad. Continue reading...
body.zh: 科学家表示，研究表明眨眼可能在狗和人之间的互动中具有社会意义。凝视狗的眼睛，你可能会遇到困惑的表情。但研究人员发现，当狗看到主人眨眼时，它们会更频繁地眨眼，这表明相互凝视可能比眼神所表达的更多。科学家此前发现，当人类看着狗时，狗会睁开小狗的眼睛，它们的大脑可以区分快乐的人脸和其他表情，甚至可以区分出恐惧的脸和愤怒或悲伤的脸。继续阅读...

It reminds us that wisdom and understanding can be found not only in grand pronouncements but also in the quiet observations of the natural world, much like Job learned from the beasts of the field. Even in the seemingly simple act of blinking, there's a...
reflection.zh: 关于狗狗眨眼的研究，让我们得以一窥生物之间微妙的沟通和连接方式。它提醒我们，智慧和理解不仅在于宏大的宣告，也存在于对自然世界的静默观察之中，正如约伯从田间的走兽那里所学到的。即使在看似简单的眨眼动作中，也蕴含着一种等待被理解的共同语言。

But what’s the science behind creatine, and does the evidence stack up? Madeleine Finlay hears from science editor Ian Sample and Dr Justin Roberts, professor of nutritional physiology at Anglia Ruskin University Continue reading...

title.en: Court blocks Trump FCC order that could flood broadcast TV with more election ads
title.zh: 法院阻止特朗普联邦通信委员会的命令，该命令可能会在广播电视上投放更多选举广告

summary.en: Republicans demanded that parties and fundraising committees be given lowest ad rates.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A federal appeals court yesterday blocked a Trump administration decision that could have resulted in even more political advertisements appearing on broadcast television during the upcoming elections. The Federal Communications Commission recently ordered broadcasters to offer the lowest advertising rates to political parties and joint fundraising committees. Four Democratic candidates challenged the decision in court, saying that only individual candidates are entitled under US law to receive what is called the "lowest unit charge," or LUC. In a 2-1 vote, a judges' panel at the US Court of Appeals for the 4th Circuit agreed with the candidates and set aside the FCC decision that was scheduled to take effect on September 4. That's the start date of the 60-day period before the election in which broadcasters must offer the lowest ad rates to qualified candidates. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 联邦上诉法院昨天驳回了特朗普政府的一项决定，该决定可能导致在即将到来的选举期间广播电视上出现更多的政治广告。美国联邦通信委员会最近命令广播公司向政党和联合筹款委员会提供最低的广告费。四名民主党候选人在法庭上对这一决定提出质疑，称根据美国法律，只有个人候选人才有权获得所谓的“最低单位费用”（LUC）。美国第四巡回上诉法院的法官小组以 2 比 1 的投票结果同意候选人的观点，并搁置了原定于 9 月 4 日生效的 FCC 决定。这是选举前 60 天期限的开始日期，在此期间广播公司必须向合格候选人提供最低广告费率。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Xbox boss 'thinking about affordability' of next-gen console
title.zh: Xbox 老板“考虑下一代游戏机的承受能力”

summary.en: In an exclusive interview with the BBC, Asha Sharma also discusses giving gamers digital versions of games they own.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Xbox chief executive Asha Sharma says the gaming giant needs to be "thinking about" affordability for its next-generation console, amid a "crisis" in computing prices.

In an interview with the BBC, she said rising hardware costs partly driven by AI spending mean firms need to find ways to make gaming affordable.

She also revealed gamers will soon be able to get digital versions of many of the physical games they currently own, potentially meaning their old games can be played on future Xbox consoles without having to put a disc in a drive.

"I know players love physical media, and I know there's a lot of benefits in digital media, and I want to make sure people have a choice," Sharma said.

Currently, digital games can be downloaded online and played across Xbox consoles or PCs.

But some players prefer discs, with one of the main benefits being they can be bought and sold second-hand.

The topic has proven controversial, with Sony announcing new PlayStation games will no longer be released on discs from January 2028 , and the hotly-anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI similarly launching without a physical disc .

"We're announcing the ability for players for 1,000 titles with physical discs to be able to have a digital entitlement."

If a disc is sold second-hand, the digital rights would transfer over to the new owner.

Players will be able to access the feature by inserting one of the supported games into their Xbox console. And Sharma hinted it meant gamers would be able to play their old titles on future hardware.

"We've long pioneered backwards compatibility and so you'll continue to see that as we go forward in the generations," she said.

But she would not reveal whether Xbox's next-generation console - currently codenamed Project Helix - will have a disc drive at all.

"This next generation, we have to be thinking about efficiency and affordability alongside performance," she added.

For the first time in the history of gaming, consoles across the board have seen price hikes years after they came out.

This is partly due to component costs such as Ram skyrocketing in price as AI companies buy up all the parts for their data centres.

"All of the industry needs to start to innovate on affordability and efficiency. That is something that we have not had to do [previously].

"But with the crisis that's currently happening in hardware and components , it is absolutely something all of us need to be thinking about and innovating on and giving people more choice in terms of how they play their console and how they purchase their console."

Xbox is part of Microsoft, which is one of the companies ploughing the most money into AI infrastructure, which in turn puts the prices of hardware components up.

"Our job as Xbox, as we continue on in our next...
body.zh: Xbox 首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 表示，在计算价格的“危机”中，这家游戏巨头需要“考虑”其下一代游戏机的承受能力。 她在接受 BBC 采访时表示，硬件成本上涨在一定程度上是由人工智能支出推动的，这意味着公司需要找到让游戏价格实惠的方法。 她还透露，游戏玩家很快就能获得他们目前拥有的许多实体游戏的数字版本，这可能意味着他们的旧游戏可以在未来的 Xbox 游戏机上玩，而无需将光盘放入驱动器中。 “我知道玩家喜欢实体媒体，我也知道数字媒体有很多好处，我想确保人们有选择，”夏尔马说。 目前，数字游戏可以在线下载并在 Xbox 游戏机或 PC 上玩。 但有些玩家更喜欢光盘，其主要好处之一是可以买卖二手光盘。 事实证明，这个话题颇具争议，索尼宣布从 2028 年 1 月起，新的 PlayStation 游戏将不再以光盘形式发行，而备受期待的《侠盗猎车手 VI》也同样在没有实体光盘的情况下推出。 “我们宣布，拥有 1,000 款实体光盘游戏的玩家将能够获得数字授权。” 如果光盘被出售为二手，则数字版权将转移给新所有者。 玩家将能够通过将受支持的游戏之一插入其 Xbox 主机来访问该功能。夏尔马暗示，这意味着玩家将能够在未来的硬件上玩他们的旧游戏。 她说：“我们长期以来一直是向后兼容的先驱，因此，随着我们几代人的前进，您将继续看到这一点。” 但她不愿透露 Xbox 的下一代游戏机（目前代号为 Project Helix）是否会有光盘驱动器。 “对于下一代，我们必须在性能的同时考虑效率和承受能力，”她补充道。 游戏史上第一次，所有游戏机在问世多年后价格都出现上涨。 这在一定程度上是由于人工智能公司购买了数据中心的所有部件，导致 RAM 等部件成本飞涨。 “整个行业都需要开始在可承受性和效率方面进行创新。这是我们（以前）不需要做的事情。 “但鉴于目前硬件和组件领域正在发生的危机，这绝对是我们所有人都需要思考和创新的事情，并为人们在如何玩游戏机以及如何购买游戏机方面提供更多选择。” Xbox 是微软的一部分，微软是在人工智能基础设施上投入最多资金的公司之一，这反过来又推高了硬件组件的价格。 “我们作为 Xbox 的工作，我们将继续我们的下一个......

title.en: Researchers get two genetic codes to work at the same time
title.zh: 研究人员让两种遗传密码同时发挥作用

summary.en: Messing with the genetic code might have gotten a bit easier to do.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The genetic code is what life everywhere uses to convert the information contained in DNA into specific protein sequences. With minor variations, the same genetic code is used by every living thing on Earth, suggesting it was already present in the last common ancestor of all of it. It's not an easy thing to change, because so many things in every cell depend on it. Nevertheless, some preliminary steps have been taken. Researchers have managed to add some new amino acids to a bacterial cell and were able to make proteins that were one amino acid less than usual. But it's a slog; for some of this work, people have had to re-engineer every single gene in a bacterial genome. Now, researchers have found a way to operate two separate genetic codes simultaneously, avoiding the need to do any work to compensate for altering the code that every protein in a cell relies on. They didn't test it in an actual cell, and it might cause some problems there. But it's a creative solution that should accelerate some synthetic biology work. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 世界各地的生命都利用遗传密码将 DNA 中包含的信息转换为特定的蛋白质序列。尽管存在微小的差异，但地球上的所有生物都使用相同的遗传密码，这表明它已经存在于所有生物的最后一个共同祖先中。改变并不是一件容易的事，因为每个细胞中的很多东西都依赖于它。尽管如此，已经采取了一些初步措施。研究人员成功地向细菌细胞中添加了一些新的氨基酸，并能够制造出比平常少一个氨基酸的蛋白质。但这是一个艰难的过程；对于其中的一些工作，人们必须重新设计细菌基因组中的每一个基因。现在，研究人员找到了一种同时操作两个独立遗传密码的方法，从而无需进行任何工作来补偿细胞中每个蛋白质所依赖的密码的改变。他们没有在实际的电池中对其进行测试，这可能会导致一些问题。但这是一个创造性的解决方案，应该会加速一些合成生物学的工作。阅读全文 评论

title.en: 15,000 years of solar wind in four hours? A Seattle company gives it a go.
title.zh: 太阳风在四小时内运行一万五千年？西雅图的一家公司尝试了一下。

summary.en: "We're living in this world of scarcity with the Moon."
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: As part of its nuclear fusion processes, the Sun produces a particularly interesting isotope of helium, known as helium-3. Some of this helium-3 escapes the Sun's gravitational pull as part of the solar wind, a stream of charged particles that emanates out across the Solar System. Over billions of years, this wind has bombarded every body in the vicinity of the Sun, including Earth's Moon. Lacking a magnetic field or atmosphere, the Moon's surface has no barrier to prevent the constant flow of this wind. This means that helium-3 has been striking the lunar soil, or regolith, for a long time. These helium ions penetrate only a little way into the individual grains of this soil, but periodically meteorites have struck the lunar surface to churn the soil, mixing some of this helium-3 a little below the surface. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 作为核聚变过程的一部分，太阳会产生一种特别有趣的氦同位素，称为氦 3。其中一些氦 3 作为太阳风的一部分逃脱了太阳的引力，太阳风是一股穿过太阳系的带电粒子流。数十亿年来，这种风轰炸了太阳附近的每一个天体，包括地球的月球。由于缺乏磁场或大气层，月球表面没有任何障碍物可以阻止这种风的持续流动。这意味着氦 3 长期以来一直在撞击月球土壤或风化层。这些氦离子只能渗透到土壤的各个颗粒中一小部分，但陨石会定期撞击月球表面，搅动土壤，将一些氦-3 混合在地表以下一点的地方。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Meta agrees to pay up to $18bn to settle social media case
title.zh: Meta 同意支付高达 180 亿美元来解决社交媒体案件

summary.en: The deal has been reached during a California federal court trial over claims brought by US states.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Social media giant Meta has reached a settlement with US states and territories to resolve a court case related to child safety on Facebook and Instagram.

The tech company says it will pay a maximum of $18bn (£13.3bn) to 48 states, plus the District of Columbia and three US territories.

The settlement requires Meta to introduce certain rules for teenage users, including daily limits and night-time blocks.

It was alleged the company had violated numerous federal and state privacy laws for children.

The states suing Meta claimed it used its platforms "to entice, engage, and ultimately ensnare youth and teens," and ignored the damage they did to the "mental and physical wellbeing of America's youth".

After the settlement was announced, District of Columbia Attorney General Brian Schwalb called it a "monumental public health victory".

He added: "The safety features Meta is required to install will fundamentally and immediately change how young people use Instagram and Facebook."

Safety features Meta will need to introduce include limiting access for children during school hours, stronger parental controls and robust age verification for underage users.

"Today, we are announcing an agreement with a bipartisan group of 52 attorneys general across US states, territories, and the District of Columbia, building on our longstanding efforts to empower parents and support teens," Meta said in a statement.

"The agreement includes a payment of approximately $18 billion, which can be used to fund youth online safety initiatives, among other state priorities.

But the company said TikTok and YouTube should also implement the same safety features for their younger users.

"Our new Time Limit commitments, Night Mode features and usage limits during school hours set the right path forward for our whole industry, but this framework will only work if all our peers join us," Meta's chief legal officer CJ Mahoney said.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 社交媒体巨头 Meta 已与美国各州和领地达成和解，以解决与 Facebook 和 Instagram 儿童安全相关的法庭案件。 这家科技公司表示，将向 48 个州以及哥伦比亚特区和三个美国领地支付最多 180 亿美元（133 亿英镑）的资金。 和解协议要求 Meta 为青少年用户引入某些规则，包括每日限制和夜间限制。 据称该公司违反了多项联邦和州儿童隐私法。 起诉 Meta 的州声称其利用其平台“引诱、吸引并最终诱骗青少年和青少年”，并忽视了这些平台对“美国年轻人的身心健康”造成的损害。 和解协议宣布后，哥伦比亚特区总检察长布莱恩·施瓦尔布称其为“公共卫生领域的巨大胜利”。 他补充道：“Meta 需要安装的安全功能将从根本上立即改变年轻人使用 Instagram 和 Facebook 的方式。” Meta 需要引入的安全功能包括限制儿童在上课时间的访问、更强的家长控制以及针对未成年用户的强大年龄验证。 Meta 在一份声明中表示：“今天，我们宣布与美国各州、领地和哥伦比亚特区的 52 名总检察长组成的两党团体达成一项协议，以我们长期以来为父母赋权和支持青少年的努力为基础。” “该协议包括支付约 180 亿美元，可用于资助青少年在线安全举措以及其他国家优先事项。 但该公司表示，TikTok 和 YouTube 也应该为其年轻用户实施相同的安全功能。 Meta 的首席法律官 CJ Mahoney 表示：“我们新的时间限制承诺、夜间模式功能和上课时间的使用限制为我们整个行业设定了正确的前进道路，但只有我们所有的同行都加入我们，这个框架才能发挥作用。” 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。
